svg.aria-label: MarketMirror in one loop: a Fitloop ad is tested on six simulated buyers in Pune, Nairobi, Manila, Austin, Taipei and Milan. They scroll, stop, click, save or hide it, two of them argue about the free trial, the survey shows 31% yes, 46% maybe and 23% no, and the verdict is iterate: say no card needed in line one. Illustration with simulated numbers.

svg.text: Rehearse your launch on simulated buyers before you spend a cent.

g.text: Joseph: trials always want my card
Ana: this one didn’t ask for it
Fix: say “no card needed” in line one.

svg.text: Illustration. Fitloop is an invented app; the numbers are simulated.
